notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]v1.1.0[/h1]

[list]
[*] Translation: Chinese translation edits.
[*] Bug fix: Resolved special effect rendering glitches when regional format of operating system is set to certain regions such as Europe and South America.
[*] Bug fix: Fixed occasional file loading errors that made it impossible to progress.
[*] Bug fix: Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]
